description: Angular component for managing device entities in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, profile handling, and user interactions.

classes.name: DeviceComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to handle device-specific logic, form management, and user interactions within the Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes device scope and credentials, and calls parent ngOnInit.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on configuration.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the device is assigned to a customer based on customerId.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for device data, with validation and value change handling.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with new device entity data.

methods.name: onDeviceIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when device ID is copied.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileUpdated
methods.description: Refreshes data when device profile is updated.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device profile, updating device data accordingly.
